newsitem.title: USA: National Patent repays $6.8 mln of debt.
newsitem.headline: National Patent repays $6.8 mln of debt.

text.p: National Patent Development Corp said Tuesday that it has repaid its 12 percent subordinated exchangeable debentures due in July. The company said the final payment of about $6.8 million, including accrued interest, was made in cash on June 30.
The company said that as a result, annual interest expenses will be reduced by about $1 million.
The company also said it has accomplished its objective of reducing its total long-term indebtedness to about $6 million from more than $275 million in 1987.
Because of its improved financial condition, National Patent said it plans to expand the technical services division of General Physics, its principal operating subsidiary.
National Patent provides training services to manufacturing and process industries, electric utilities and government agencies.
